name: Lilian
source:
Human/Clone

A mysterious and beautiful woman with a striking resemblance to Lien’s deceased mother due to being her clone.

What secrets does she know by being at Seon’s side?

[From [url=http://altabestudio.com/works/ea-pinocchio/]official site[/url]]
